title: Playboy Magazine June 1966 Girls of Texas Mike Nichols Interview Bogart Boom
conditionDescription: Handwritten name on the front cover, heavy cover wear and soiling, back cover loose at the spine. Complete. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, June 1966 issue. Cover price 75 cents.

Features:
- The Girls of Texas
- Playboy Interview with Mike Nichols
- The Bogart Boom, by Kenneth Tynan and Bosley Crowther

Cowgirl-with-six-shooter cover. The back cover carries a 1966 Martini & Rossi vermouth ad with the black cat.

Condition: Reading copy with heavy wear, priced accordingly. A previous subscriber's name and number are handwritten in pen on the front cover; cover shows soiling, toning, creasing and edge wear, and the back cover is loose/torn along the spine (see close-ups). Complete. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review all photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
